title: Normal-Euler excess for disjoint nonorientable surfaces in a closed $4$-manifold
summary: Let \(M\) be a closed connected oriented topological \(4\)-manifold. We prove that if \(F_1,\dots,F_r\subset M\) are pairwise disjoint connected locally flat topologically embedded nonorientable surfaces with nonorientable genera \(g_i\), same-sign twisted normal Euler numbers \(e_i\), and \( [F_1]+\cdots+[F_r]=0\in H_2(M;\F_2), \) then the normal-Euler excess \( \sum_{i=1}^r \bigl(\abs{e_i}-2g_i\bigr) \) is bounded above by a constant depending only on \(M\).
